"""Command-line interface: `python3 -m kitty COMMAND ...`."""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import sys

from kitty import core
from kitty.core import KittyError


class _Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    """Argument parser that reports mistakes with exit status 1."""

    def error(self, message):
        self.print_usage(sys.stderr)
        self.exit(1, "Error: {}\n".format(message))


def build_parser():
    parser = _Parser(prog="python3 -m kitty",
                     description="Track shared trip costs and work out who owes whom.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", metavar="COMMAND")
    commands.required = True

    p = commands.add_parser("init", help="start a new kitty")
    p.add_argument("currency", help="main currency, e.g. EUR")

    member = commands.add_parser("member", help="add, remove or list group members")
    member_cmds = member.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    member_cmds.required = True
    member_cmds.add_parser("add", help="add someone").add_argument("name")
    member_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="remove someone").add_argument("name")
    member_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list everyone")

    expense = commands.add_parser("expense", help="add, remove or list expenses")
    expense_cmds = expense.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    expense_cmds.required = True
    p = expense_cmds.add_parser("add", help="record that someone paid for something")
    p.add_argument("payer")
    p.add_argument("amount")
    p.add_argument("description", nargs="+")
    p.add_argument("--among", metavar="A,B", help="split equally between only these people")
    p.add_argument("--exact", metavar="A=30,B=20", help="split by exact amounts")
    p.add_argument("--shares", metavar="A=2,B=1", help="split by shares")
    p.add_argument("--percent", metavar="A=60,B=40", help="split by percentages")
    p.add_argument("--currency", help="currency it was paid in (default: main currency)")
    p.add_argument("--date", help="YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)")
    p.add_argument("--category", help='e.g. food (default: "other")')
    expense_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list all expenses")
    expense_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="delete an expense").add_argument("id")

    payment = commands.add_parser("payment", help="record someone paying someone back")
    payment_cmds = payment.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    payment_cmds.required = True
    p = payment_cmds.add_parser("add", help="FROM paid AMOUNT to TO")
    p.add_argument("sender", metavar="FROM")
    p.add_argument("receiver", metavar="TO")
    p.add_argument("amount")
    p.add_argument("--currency", help="currency it was paid in (default: main currency)")
    p.add_argument("--date", help="YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)")

    rate = commands.add_parser("rate", help="set exchange rates")
    rate_cmds = rate.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    rate_cmds.required = True
    p = rate_cmds.add_parser("set", help="one CURRENCY is worth RATE of the main currency")
    p.add_argument("currency")
    p.add_argument("rate")

    commands.add_parser("balances", help="how far up or down each person is")
    commands.add_parser("settle", help="suggest who should pay whom")
    commands.add_parser("history", help="everything that affected one person").add_argument("name")
    commands.add_parser("report", help="each person's share of spending per category")
    commands.add_parser("export", help="save expenses to a CSV file").add_argument("file")
    return parser


def print_json(value):
    print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))


def run(args):
    if args.command == "init":
        currency = core.parse_currency(args.currency)
        if os.path.exists(core.kitty_path()):
            raise KittyError("There's already a kitty in this folder ({}). "
                             "Delete or move it first to start over.".format(core.FILENAME))
        core.save(core.new_kitty(currency))
        print("Started a new kitty in {}.".format(currency))
        return

    data = core.load()
    cmd = (args.command, getattr(args, "action", None))

    if cmd == ("member", "add"):
        name = core.add_member(data, args.name)
        core.save(data)
        print("Added {}.".format(name))
    elif cmd == ("member", "remove"):
        core.remove_member(data, args.name)
        core.save(data)
        print("Removed {}.".format(args.name))
    elif cmd == ("member", "list"):
        print_json(data["members"])
    elif cmd == ("expense", "add"):
        expense = core.add_expense(
            data, args.payer, args.amount, " ".join(args.description),
            currency=args.currency, date=args.date, category=args.category,
            among=args.among, exact=args.exact, shares=args.shares, percent=args.percent)
        core.save(data)
        print(expense["id"])
    elif cmd == ("expense", "list"):
        print_json(core.list_expenses(data))
    elif cmd == ("expense", "remove"):
        expense = core.remove_expense(data, args.id)
        core.save(data)
        print("Removed expense {} ({}).".format(expense["id"], expense["description"]))
    elif cmd == ("payment", "add"):
        payment = core.add_payment(data, args.sender, args.receiver, args.amount,
                                   currency=args.currency, date=args.date)
        core.save(data)
        print("Recorded {} paying {} {} {}.".format(
            payment["from"], payment["to"], payment["amount"], payment["currency"]))
    elif cmd == ("rate", "set"):
        currency, _ = core.set_rate(data, args.currency, args.rate)
        core.save(data)
        print("1 {} = {} {}.".format(currency, data["rates"][currency], data["currency"]))
    elif args.command == "balances":
        print_json({m: core.format_money(c) for m, c in core.balances(data).items()})
    elif args.command == "settle":
        print_json(core.settle(data))
    elif args.command == "history":
        print_json(core.history(data, args.name))
    elif args.command == "report":
        print_json(core.report(data))
    elif args.command == "export":
        export(data, args.file)


def export(data, filename):
    target = os.path.abspath(filename)
    if os.path.basename(target) == core.FILENAME or target == os.path.abspath(core.kitty_path()):
        raise KittyError("Refusing to overwrite {} - pick another file name.".format(core.FILENAME))
    with open(target, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(core.EXPORT_COLUMNS)
        writer.writerows(core.export_rows(data))
    print("Saved {} expense(s) to {}.".format(len(data["expenses"]), filename))


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        run(args)
    except KittyError as e:
        print("Error: {}".format(e), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except OSError as e:
        print("Error: couldn't access {}: {}".format(e.filename or "a file", e.strerror or e),
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0

import unittest

class KittyTest(unittest.TestCase):

        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = self._tmp.name

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=PROJECT)
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "kitty", *args], cwd=self.dir,
                              env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)

    def ok(self, *args):
        result = self.run_kitty(*args)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return result.stdout.strip()

    def json(self, *args):
        return json.loads(self.ok(*args))

    def fails(self, *args):
        result = self.run_kitty(*args)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("Error:", result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", result.stderr)
        return result.stderr

    def group(self, *names):
        self.ok("init", "EUR")
        for n in names:
            self.ok("member", "add", n)

    def test_sams_examples(self):
        self.group("Alice", "Bob")
        self.ok("rate", "set", "USD", "0.92")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("expense", "add", "Alice", "45", "Dinner", "--currency", "USD",
                                 "--date", "2026-07-14", "--category", "food"), "1")
        self.assertEqual(self.json("member", "list"), ["Alice", "Bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.json("expense", "list"), [{
            "id": 1, "date": "2026-07-14", "payer": "Alice", "description": "Dinner",
            "amount": "45.00", "currency": "USD", "base_amount": "41.40", "category": "food",
            "shares": {"Alice": "20.70", "Bob": "20.70"}}])
        self.assertEqual(self.json("balances"), {"Alice": "20.70", "Bob": "-20.70"})
        self.assertEqual(self.json("settle"), [{"from": "Bob", "to": "Alice", "amount": "20.70"}])
        self.assertEqual(self.json("history", "Bob"), [{
            "date": "2026-07-14", "description": "Dinner", "change": "-20.70", "balance": "-20.70"}])
        self.assertEqual(self.json("report"), {"food": {"Alice": "20.70", "Bob": "20.70"}})

    def test_kitty_json_in_current_folder(self):
        self.ok("init", "eur")
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "kitty.json")) as f:
            self.assertEqual(json.load(f)["currency"], "EUR")

    def test_defaults_and_uneven_cents(self):
        self.group("A", "B", "C")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "10", "Coffee", "and", "cake")
        [e] = self.json("expense", "list")
        self.assertEqual(e["category"], "other")
        self.assertEqual(e["description"], "Coffee and cake")
        self.assertEqual(len(e["date"]), 10)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(e["shares"].values()), ["3.33", "3.33", "3.34"])

    def test_split_options(self):
        self.group("A", "B", "C")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "50", "x", "--among", "A,B")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "50", "x", "--exact", "B=30,C=20")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "30", "x", "--shares", "B=2,C=1")

            {"B": "60.00", "C": "40.00"},

        [e] = self.json("expense", "list")
        total = sum(round(float(v) * 100) for v in e["shares"].values())
        self.assertEqual(total, round(float(e["base_amount"]) * 100))

        self.group("A", "B", "C", "D")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "100", "x")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "B", "33.33", "y", "--among", "B,C,D")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "C", "7", "z", "--shares", "A=1,D=3")
        self.ok("payment", "add", "D", "A", "10")
        balances = self.json("balances")
        cents = {m: round(float(v) * 100) for m, v in balances.items()}
        self.assertEqual(sum(cents.values()), 0)
        for t in self.json("settle"):
            self.ok("payment", "add", t["from"], t["to"], t["amount"])
        self.assertEqual(set(self.json("balances").values()), {"0.00"})
        self.assertEqual(self.json("settle"), [])

        self.group("A", "B")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "20", "Later", "--date", "2026-07-15")
        self.ok("payment", "add", "B", "A", "4", "--date", "2026-07-14")
        rows = self.json("history", "B")
        self.assertEqual([r["description"] for r in rows], ["Payment to A", "Later"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["balance"], self.json("balances")["B"])

        self.group("A", "B")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "30", "x", "--category", "food", "--shares", "A=1,B=2")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "B", "8", "y")
        self.assertEqual(self.json("report"), {
            "food": {"A": "10.00", "B": "20.00"}, "other": {"A": "4.00", "B": "4.00"}})

    def test_expense_remove(self):
        self.group("A", "B")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x")
        self.ok("expense", "remove", "1")
        self.assertEqual(self.json("expense", "list"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x"), "2")

    def test_export(self):
        self.group("A", "B")
        self.ok("rate", "set", "USD", "0.5")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "10", "Dinner, with wine", "--currency", "USD", "--date", "2026-07-14")
        self.ok("export", "out.csv")
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, "out.csv"), newline="") as f:
            rows = list(csv.reader(f))
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            ["id", "date", "payer", "description", "amount", "currency", "category", "base_amount"],
            ["1", "2026-07-14", "A", "Dinner, with wine", "10.00", "USD", "other", "5.00"]])

    def test_mistakes_exit_1(self):
        self.fails("balances")  # no kitty yet
        self.group("A", "B")
        self.fails("init", "EUR")  # already exists
        self.fails("member", "add", "A")
        self.fails("member", "remove", "Z")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "Z", "10", "x")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "ten", "x")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "0", "x")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "1.234", "x")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--currency", "USD")  # no rate
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--date", "14/07/2026")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--among", "A,Z")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--exact", "A=5,B=4")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--percent", "A=50,B=40")
        self.fails("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--shares", "A=x")

        self.fails("expense", "remove", "7")
        self.fails("payment", "add", "A", "A", "5")
        self.fails("rate", "set", "EUR", "2")
        self.fails("rate", "set", "USD", "-1")
        self.fails("history", "Z")
        self.fails("export", "kitty.json")
        self.fails("nonsense")
        self.fails("expense")
        self.assertEqual(self.json("expense", "list"), [])

    def test_cannot_remove_member_with_expenses(self):
        self.group("A", "B", "C")
        self.ok("expense", "add", "A", "10", "x", "--among", "A,B")
        self.fails("member", "remove", "B")
        self.ok("member", "remove", "C")
        self.assertEqual(self.json("member", "list"), ["A", "B"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# kitty

Keeps track of shared trip costs, so at the end you know who owes whom.
It only needs the Python 3 that comes with macOS. Run it from this folder:

    python3 -m kitty init EUR
    python3 -m kitty member add Alice
    python3 -m kitty member add Bob
    python3 -m kitty expense add Alice 45 Dinner --category food
    python3 -m kitty balances
    python3 -m kitty settle

Run `python3 -m kitty --help` (or e.g. `python3 -m kitty expense add --help`) to see every command.
Everything is saved in `kitty.json` in the folder you run it from.

## Notes for scripts

- Reports print one line of JSON. Money is text with two decimals, in the main
  currency, except an expense's own `amount`.
- `expense add` prints only the new expense's ID. Other commands that change
  something print a short confirmation line.
- Errors go to stderr starting with `Error:`, and exit status is 1.
- Descriptions can be several words without quotes (`expense add Alice 45 Dinner at Luigi's`).
  To be safe with special characters, quote them.

## How the numbers work

- Amounts can have at most two decimals and must be more than zero.
- The exchange rate is saved with each expense or payment when you add it.
  Changing a rate later only affects new entries. You have to set a rate
  before using a foreign currency.
- Shares are always worked out in the main currency and always add up exactly
  to the expense's `base_amount`. If it doesn't divide evenly, the leftover
  cents go to the people with the biggest rounding loss, earliest in the group first.
- `--exact` amounts are in the expense's own currency and must add up to the amount.
  `--percent` must add up to 100.
- "Split between everyone" means everyone in the group when the expense was added.
  People added later don't take part in earlier expenses.
- Someone who is part of any expense or payment can't be removed from the group.
- `history` also shows payments ("Payment to Bob" / "Payment from Alice").
  It's sorted by date, then by the order things were entered.
- `report` lists every current member under every category, showing `"0.00"`
  when someone has no share.

## Tests

    python3 -m unittest discover tests
